document.summary: NBT Viewer — a client-side Fabric mod that reads the NBT / data-component data your client already has for items, blocks and entities, with no /data access. Minecraft 1.20–26.2.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.content:
**NBT Viewer** is a client-side [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) mod that surfaces the NBT / data-component data the game already sends to your client — for **items**, **blocks / block entities**, and **entities** — without needing operator `/data` access.

It only shows data the vanilla client already has, so it works on any server; in singleplayer (or on servers that also run it) it can pull the full block-entity and entity NBT.

sections.title: Features
sections.content:
- **Searchable tree GUI** — a full-screen, collapsible NBT tree with substring or regex search, a live match count, keyboard navigation, and recursive fold.
- **Copy & export** — copy the whole tree, a node, a bare value, or an SNBT path; or save to a timestamped `.snbt` file for data too large for the clipboard.
- **HUD overlay** — live NBT of the current target in any screen corner: always, while a key is held, or while sneaking.
- **`/viewdata` command** (alias `/nbtview`) — inspect by crosshair, held item, slot, coordinates, network id, UUID, entity type, player name, or a vanilla `@e[…]` selector, with a picker when several match.
- **Rebindable hotkeys**, a **Jade** tooltip extension, and a Mod Menu + JSON config screen.

sections.title: Installation
sections.content: Drop the jar for your Minecraft version into `.minecraft/mods/` alongside Fabric API.

sections.title: Usage
sections.content:
| Key / command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `N` | Open NBT of the target (block ▸ entity ▸ item) |
| `/viewdata … gui · copy · save` | Inspect to the screen, clipboard, or a file |
| `/viewdata entity <id · uuid · type · @e[…]>` | Target something you can't aim at |
| `Ctrl+F · Ctrl+C · Ctrl+B · Ctrl+S` | Search · copy node · copy value · save |
| `Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→` | Collapse / expand the selected subtree |
